summary: Cek Harga kiosk with new MikoRig 2.5D character tested end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844). All 6 requested flows PASS: (1) Idle screen renders with Miko mascot on pedestal, (2) Buat PIN modal accepts 1234/1234 and enters kiosk, (3) Typed search 'beras' returns 24 product cards with 'Pilih Barang' title + countdown, (4) Selecting the beras Rp 13.700 card shows result card (testID cekharga-result) with MikoRig rendered ABOVE it (Miko y=214.5 < Result y=332.5) + countdown, (5) Back arrow returns to idle via exit-pin modal (kiosk-back opens exit modal by design; pick-back on selection screens returns directly to idle), (6) No console errors, no red-screen, no crashes. All 12 miko_rig PNG frames load correctly. TTS audio/mouth-sync not validated (native-only, as per request). No regressions found.
critical_code_review_comments: cek-harga.tsx is 1015 lines — consider splitting into subcomponents (PinModals, KioskIdle, SearchResults, ResultCard, MikoChat) for maintainability, but not blocking.
MikoRig `initial` prop is captured only on first render via useRef(initial); prop changes will be ignored — currently fine because callers pass a static initial state.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data; existing product 'beras' Rp 13.700 was used as target.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only test. Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Cek Harga has 'Buat PIN Admin' first-run modal (SecureStore doesn't persist on web -> modal appears every session; use 1234/1234). Top-left back arrow (kiosk-back) opens exit PIN modal by design (kiosk lock); to return to idle from search selection use 'pick-back' inside pickHeader; from result, wait for 15s auto-countdown. MikoRig sprite frames live in /app/frontend/assets/miko_rig/ (12 PNGs).
